title: Indeed you possess two traits that Allah loves: prudence and deliberation
hadeeth: Ibn ‘Abbās (may Allah be pleased with him and his father) reported: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said to Al-Ashajj, Ashajj ‘Abdul-Qays: "Indeed you possess two traits that Allah loves: prudence and deliberation."
explanation: The Prophet (may Allah's peace and blessings be upon him) said to Al-Mundhir ibn ‘Ā’idh, known as Al-Ashajj of the tribe of ‘Abdul-Qays and its leader (may Allah be pleased with him): Indeed, you possess two traits that Allah loves: reason, calm deliberation, sobriety, and avoiding haste.
hints: Encouraging the adoption of prudence and deliberation.
Encouraging deliberation in matters and the consideration of consequences.
Prudence and deliberation are among the praiseworthy traits.
One should praise Allah Almighty for the good character traits He has naturally instilled in him.
"Al-Ashajj" refers to someone who has been injured with a wound on the face, head, or forehead.
hadeeth_intro: Ibn ‘Abbās (may Allah be pleased with him and his father) reported:
hadeeth_ar: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضيَ اللهُ عنهما قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ صَلَّى اللهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ لِلْأَشَجِّ أَشَجِّ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ: «إِنَّ فِيكَ خَصْلَتَيْنِ يُحِبُّهُمَا اللهُ: الْحِلْمُ، وَالْأَنَاةُ».
hadeeth_intro_ar: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ رَضيَ اللهُ عنهما قَالَ:
explanation_ar:
قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم للمنذر بن عائذ أشج قبيلة عبد القيس ورئيسها رضي الله عنه: 

إن فيك صفتين يحبهما الله، وهما: العقل، والتثبت والوقار وعدم العجلة.
hints_ar: الحض على التثبت في الأمور والنظر في العواقب.
حمد الإنسان لله تعالى على ما جبله عليه من الأخلاق الحميدة.
الأشج من أصيب بجُرح في الوجه، أو الرَّأس، أو الجبين.
